review_method.scope: Every deduplicated cap or unstated claim in summaries 07 and 08 was read, then high-consequence verdict, capture, promotion, scorecard, proposal, and headline cases were traced to source context.
review_method.cap_rule: A cap establishes only the observations inside the cap. No numerator was derived from a cap.
review_method.status_rule: SUPERSEDED means the source already records the correction; it is not a currently live wrong verdict. CAVEATED means the observation survives only at its stated population. LIVE includes explicit UNMEASURED states, not implied passes.
review_method.evidence_rule: VERIFIED_BY_RUNNING is reserved for an adjudicator-run check. These source conclusions were adjudicated by source and existing-artifact reading, so findings are labeled INFERRED_BY_READING.

headline: No currently live wrong PASS/FAIL verdict was established. Seven verdict or headline reversals are real but already documented and superseded: V-EYES's 13-frame ceiling, V-GATHER's nsrc=10 denominator and certificate sign correction, the proposal's NO_COMMON_K phase-1 refutation, M90 Round 2, M20's 15.1% corpus figure, and the V-HEADTOHEAD2 Zerene deficit. Live denominator risk remains explicit and unresolved for M107's 3/5 A1 score, unexhausted V-GATHER ceilings, the M89 census claim, M90's capped six-stack blast-radius range, the BUILD-CROP proxy headline, and M26's three-frame-per-stack saturation headline.

denominator_chain: band-0 averaged fractions under white-floor and measured-floor arms
findings.original_conclusion: On the owner's written criteria, equal averaged fractions is FAIL and averaged falling in both arms is FAIL; the physically stated same-multiple-of-own-floor criterion is PASS.
findings.true_population: Every frame in each of the six complete brackets.
findings.missing_evidence: Full-bracket fractions are missing, but they are not needed to establish direction: lowering the plane threshold cannot raise its averaged fraction and raising the full-resolution threshold cannot lower its averaged fraction.
findings.exact_replacement_text: The reported fractions use the first 10 placed frames of each of six stacks. Full-bracket fractions remain unmeasured, but criterion 2 cannot reverse: the measured floor lowers the plane threshold and raises the full-resolution threshold. The load-bearing same-multiple-of-own-floor criterion passes at 2.00x in both arms.

denominator_chain: radius and depth regressions scored on only those three
findings.original_conclusion: A1 is ADEQUATE versus radius and INDETERMINATE versus depth.
findings.true_population: The five stacks named by the registered A1 rule.
findings.missing_evidence: Argmax volumes and the registered regressions for the two no-CPL stacks.
findings.exact_replacement_text: A1 is provisionally ADEQUATE versus radius and INDETERMINATE versus depth on 3 of 5 registered stacks. No five-stack A1 verdict exists until the two no-CPL argmax volumes are persisted and scored without changing the rule.

findings.original_conclusion: --out protects the shared cache, while a reader still uses the shared sidecar unless STREHL_CACHE_DIR is isolated.
findings.true_population: All calls through the same cache-path code; 299 frames only matter to incidence, not to path selection.
findings.missing_evidence: A full-bracket A/B would estimate incidence, but is not needed for the code-path ruling.
findings.exact_replacement_text: The six-frame run is a mechanism control, not a full-bracket incidence estimate. It establishes that --out does not mutate the shared cache; STREHL_CACHE_DIR remains the isolation primitive for both readers and writers.

denominator_chain: later max-u check found 0 of 7 subjects reached the knee
findings.original_conclusion: The null's support was materially widened to eight subjects.
findings.true_population: Subjects whose input reaches the 0.60 knee; the seven added prefixes were outside that sensitive population.
findings.missing_evidence: None for withdrawing the widening claim. A new widening claim needs a non-saturating subject that actually reaches the knee.
findings.exact_replacement_text: I retract 'widened to 8 subjects.' All seven added prefixes had max u below the 0.60 knee, so byte identity was guaranteed and supplied no null evidence. The original measured 109MSDCF null remains.

denominator_chain: 13 source frames, only 6% and 11% of their brackets
master divided by capped source maximum
findings.original_conclusion: The master was 1.87x and 1.54x sharper than its per-site best input frame.
findings.true_population: Every frame in the bracket for each subject being given a per-site best-frame ceiling.
findings.missing_evidence: Exhaustive ceilings for corpus subjects not among the five completed brackets.
findings.resolved_verdict: On averaging-dominated subjects the complete-bracket master is 5-19% softer than its per-site best input; a complete 299-frame selection-dominated subject is above parity. The measured deficit is below the reported visibility threshold.
findings.exact_replacement_text: The earlier 1.87x and 1.54x results used a 13-frame ceiling and are superseded. Across complete brackets, strehl is 5-19% softer on averaging-dominated subjects; the effect is regime-dependent and was below the measured visibility threshold.

denominator_chain: one in 30 frames on a 299-frame stack
best-source denominator held fixed in commissioning
reference-only thinning later moved readings across unity
findings.original_conclusion: Project sharpness ratios above unity and the RECONSTRUCT comparison were treated as evidence for the master.
findings.true_population: Every source frame in every bracket retained for a source-ceiling comparison.
findings.missing_evidence: Full-bracket denominators for any original subject-level ratio someone proposes to retain.
findings.resolved_verdict: The nsrc=10 denominator inflated the prior real-subject sharpness ratios; changing only the denominator moved measurements across unity.
findings.exact_replacement_text: The prior real-subject sharpness ratios used nsrc=10 and are invalid. Thinning the reference alone moved readings across unity with the master unchanged; retained ratios require every source frame or an independently justified frozen sampling design.

denominator_chain: 12 sampled frames per subject for the blotch source ceiling
registration consumer used the shift with the wrong sign
four REFUSED rows became four FAIL rows after correction
findings.original_conclusion: The first certificate partition was 17 PASS, 5 FAIL, 4 REFUSED and was later paraphrased as 17 PASS / 9 acquitted / 0 FAIL across a partial axis set.
findings.true_population: All 26 sealed subjects on every axis the certificate claims to cover.
findings.missing_evidence: None for the sign correction; the separate exhaustive-ceiling gap is recorded in the next finding.
findings.resolved_verdict: The corrected four-axis partition is 1 clean, 17 failing, and 8 unexamined on at least one axis; the four sign-caused refusals all resolve to FAIL.
findings.exact_replacement_text: The original certificate is superseded. Correcting the registration sign moved all four REFUSED subjects to FAIL; after adding the blind axes, the partition is 1 clean, 17 failing, and 8 unexamined on at least one axis.

denominator_chain: maximum source statistic among usable sampled frames
subject PASS or FAIL on the source-ceiling axis
findings.original_conclusion: The sampled source ceilings licensed subject-level certificate rows.
findings.true_population: Every source frame that covers each frozen site in all 26 brackets.
findings.missing_evidence: Complete coverage-preserving source-frame renders for deep stacks whose source ceiling remains sampled.
findings.exact_replacement_text: The registration-sign reversal is resolved, but deep-stack source-ceiling values remain conditional on sampled usable frames. Do not promote a capped ceiling to an exhaustive subject-level source maximum.

findings.original_conclusion: Deep-stack manufactured-detail excess was read against a ceiling whose coverage covaried strongly with stack depth.
findings.true_population: Every frame in each bracket; the completed deep control is all 299 frames of pencil-steep-angle-cpl.
findings.missing_evidence: Exhaustive ceiling searches for the remaining deep stacks.
findings.exact_replacement_text: The 56-render ceiling cap is a real confound. On pencil-steep-angle-cpl, exhaustive 299-frame search reduced e1 excess from 43.644% to 36.164% without changing sign; other deep-stack excess verdicts remain unresolved until their ceilings are exhaustive.

denominator_chain: field standing, common-input boundary, and native 16-bit linear-TIFF contract
findings.original_conclusion: No cheaper third-party candidate was verified to combine all three properties.
findings.missing_evidence: A frozen comparator census or one newly identified candidate with a qualifying witness. A replacement also requires a scorecard amendment because current comparators are named.
findings.exact_replacement_text: Among the named candidates examined, none was verified to combine equal field standing, a clean common-input merge boundary, and native 16-bit linear-TIFF output. This is not an exhaustive market claim, and a substitute would require a scorecard amendment.

findings.original_conclusion: M10 remains UNMEASURED_FLAT_TRUTH and has neither PASS nor FAIL.
findings.missing_evidence: An admitted output-blind face mask plus planarity certificate, or a fresh certified planar unit.
findings.exact_replacement_text: M10 flat-null truth is UNMEASURED. No PASS or FAIL may be assigned until an output-blind mask and planarity-qualified population are admitted, or a fresh certified planar target is supplied.

denominator_chain: estimator emits a ratio with an unbound 0.25% allowance
no independently truthed real-pair calibration population
findings.original_conclusion: The estimator allowance cannot be relabeled calibrated or admitted for the converter-change claim.
findings.missing_evidence: Converter-off and converter-on real captures with independent optical truth sufficient to calibrate estimator bias, followed by independent admission review.
findings.exact_replacement_text: A single unknown-ratio real pair cannot calibrate converter-dependent estimator bias. Keep the allowance uncalibrated and the converter-change behavior unadmitted until independently truthed real pairs are reviewed.

denominator_chain: 0 survivors because the gate demanded a band-constant candidate match a band-shaped target
findings.original_conclusion: NO_COMMON_K refuted Phase 1 and treated the route as dead.
findings.true_population: The complete 18-candidate grid generated by that registered width gate; its emptiness cannot answer output quality because the gate was unsatisfiable by construction.
findings.missing_evidence: A preregistered satisfiable output-quality gate and the candidate renders it permits.
findings.resolved_verdict: Phase 1 is UNTESTED, not DEAD or REFUTED. This withdraws the refutation but does not validate the merge rule.
findings.exact_replacement_text: Phase 1 is UNTESTED, not DEAD. The 0-of-18 result came from a fixed-k gate that could not match the band-shaped target by construction, so the intended Pareto frontier was never rendered. This is unvalidated, not rescued.

findings.original_conclusion: Phase 1 cannot include A2 as written; remove it or commission a new causal and tone-safe instrument.
findings.true_population: All seven gates in the frozen A2 audit instrument.
findings.missing_evidence: No denominator evidence is missing for the current STOP. A different A2 needs a newly commissioned instrument rather than extra post hoc gates.
findings.exact_replacement_text: A2 remains STOP_DO_NOT_BUILD: 0 of all 7 preregistered gates passed. The denominator is the complete frozen gate set, not an unstated sample.

findings.original_conclusion: The scoreboard remains 2 of 12; clearing isolated blockers often has zero scorecard payoff.
findings.true_population: All 12 named scorecard axes.
findings.missing_evidence: None about the denominator. Individual axis clearance still requires its own evidence.
findings.exact_replacement_text: The scoreboard denominator is the fixed set of 12 named axes. It currently reads 2 of 12; this is an administrative census, not a sample or an unstated population.

denominator_chain: 14 defective subjects enumerated by the cited README
count used to motivate a live reshoot advisor
findings.original_conclusion: Late feedback has a measured capture cost: 10 of 14 defective subjects were capture-limited.
findings.true_population: The 14 defective subjects in the cited README, not all future captures or all owner stacks.
findings.missing_evidence: A frozen broader capture census would be required for a prevalence claim beyond those 14 subjects.
findings.exact_replacement_text: In the cited 14-subject defective set, 10 verdicts were capture-limited. Use this as motivation for the advisor, not as an all-corpus or future-capture prevalence estimate.

denominator_chain: all seven curves passed and all three cases found
three bee-stack multi-peak fractions used as supporting measurements
findings.original_conclusion: The V-VEIL2 acceptance-instrument question is ALREADY ANSWERED and can close, while implementation safety remains separate.
findings.true_population: The seven validation curves, three known two-layer cases, and three bee stacks named by this gate.
findings.missing_evidence: Corpus-wide safety evidence for any particular A2 implementation; the source explicitly does not claim it.
findings.exact_replacement_text: Close V-VEIL2's instrument question on its complete named battery: 7/7 curves passed and 3/3 known two-layer cases were found. This does not certify any A2 implementation corpus-wide.

denominator_chain: named full grid, coffee-bean, foam, and N=33/100/299 systems arms
reserve explicitly excluded from current scorecard evidence
findings.original_conclusion: These named captures and hierarchy levels define future W5 scoring and reserve handling.
findings.true_population: The prospective capture set explicitly named by the W5 protocol.
findings.missing_evidence: No result exists yet; future W5 evidence must follow the sealed protocol.
findings.exact_replacement_text: This is a prospective population definition, not a measurement. Seal the named W5 manifests before rendering; keep the reserve out of current scorecard evidence.

denominator_chain: quoted M3, M4, M5, M8, and M9 scorecard thresholds
percentages define future acceptance bars rather than observed numerators
M144's 500-cell cases are explicitly labeled assumed minimum-size sensitivity
findings.original_conclusion: The quoted values define scorecard success and boundary sensitivity.
findings.true_population: Defined by each future scorecard execution; no empirical population is asserted by the quotation itself.
findings.missing_evidence: Future scored populations and outcomes. M144 intentionally models an assumed 500-cell boundary case rather than claiming a measured census.
findings.exact_replacement_text: These percentages are scorecard criteria, not measured pass fractions. M144's 500-cell examples are explicitly assumed sensitivity cases; do not classify either kind as an unstated empirical denominator.

denominator_chain: candidate M4 flat and edge captures
scorecard requires at least 500 eligible sites and 50 per capture
no scored-site manifest proves those floors
population is undefined and M4 is not executable
findings.original_conclusion: M4's capture blocker is plausible but not demonstrated; the larger blocker is an undefined scoring population.
findings.missing_evidence: An input-only scored-site manifest demonstrating at least 500 eligible sites overall and 50 per capture, with commissioning and scored inputs separated.
findings.exact_replacement_text: M4 remains UNMEASURED: no admitted site manifest defines the scored flat/edge population or proves the 500-overall and 50-per-capture floors. This is an explicit evidence gap, not an unstated pass.

denominator_chain: every output sample in the shipping Catmull-Rom M8-R trace
M8-O v1.5 has no commissioned measurement
findings.original_conclusion: Shipping Catmull-Rom fails M8-R; M8-O v1.5 is UNMEASURED.
findings.true_population: All samples in each scored M8-R capture; M8-O requires every scored final-output capture.
findings.missing_evidence: A landed corrected gather with V=0 on every scored M8-R capture and an independently recommissioned M8-O checker producing V=0 on every scored capture.
findings.exact_replacement_text: M8-R is FAIL because the exact-zero bar is violated at 1.030569% of the scored output population. M8-O v1.5 is UNMEASURED, not PASS. Clearance requires V=0 for both axes on every scored capture.

denominator_chain: complete owner-stack universe and selection rule not frozen
findings.original_conclusion: Contamination is common, 8 of 23 stacks exceed 20x the null, and lead-1-cpl is the most contaminated stack in the corpus.
findings.missing_evidence: A frozen exhaustive owner-stack manifest or a principled sampling design for corpus-wide prevalence and rank.
findings.exact_replacement_text: Within the 23 surveyed stacks, 8 exceed 20x the null and lead-1-cpl ranks highest. The exact prevalence and corpus-wide maximum remain conditional because the complete owner-stack universe and selection rule were not frozen.

denominator_chain: Round 2 measured warp correlation and resampler variance
registered sign and monotonicity prediction failed
findings.original_conclusion: Merged over-confidence reached +285.71%, rho_warp=1 supplied the bound, and the correction was positive and monotone in n_eff.
findings.true_population: The Round-2 measured pair/lag and resampler populations for the four reported stacks; broader generalization remains governed by the separate six-stack cap.
findings.missing_evidence: None for superseding the Round-1 scalar. Representative uncapped reruns are still needed for corpus-wide blast-radius ranges.
findings.resolved_verdict: rho_warp=1 is false; the scalar model is inadequate. The measured mean at n_eff=44.19 is +19.04%, the correction is negative on foam, and it is not monotone in n_eff.
findings.exact_replacement_text: Round 1's +285.71% and rho_warp=1 model are superseded. Round 2 measures a two-parameter (W, rho(d)) response: mean Delta sigma is +19.04% at n_eff=44.19, -0.76% on foam, and non-monotone in n_eff.

denominator_chain: six stacks chosen for decode speed and label clarity
stacks deeper than 60 truncated to first 60 frames
all frames and pixels inside each capped run
reported zero kappa-only selection changes and 0.0006%-0.0073% election-winner movement
findings.original_conclusion: Kappa alone is free and published images survive the default flip because election winners move on at most 0.0073% of pixels across all six stacks.
findings.true_population: Every frame and output pixel in a frozen representative target-stack population.
findings.missing_evidence: Uncapped full-stack reruns plus either an exhaustive target-stack manifest or a principled sampling design.
findings.exact_replacement_text: On the six measured runs, with deep stacks capped at their first 60 frames, kappa-only moved zero selection decisions and the combined change moved 0.0006%-0.0073% of election winners. Do not promote that observed maximum to a corpus-wide bound without uncapped representative reruns.

denominator_chain: border bug removed and residual consumer-dependent bandwidth effect diagnosed
findings.original_conclusion: The bandwidth 20% bar FAILED on 18 of 18 comparisons.
findings.true_population: All 18 comparisons in the registered bandwidth check.
findings.missing_evidence: None about the denominator. The source records that the prescribed unidentifiability exit was poorly targeted and separately shows the substantive rho_warp=1 ruling is robust at every tested bandwidth.
findings.exact_replacement_text: The registered bandwidth bar remains FAIL: all 18 planned comparisons move 27%-43% against a 20% limit. After removing border contamination, F is still consumer-bandwidth-dependent; do not reinterpret the failed bar as an unstated sample.

denominator_chain: source baseline is max over usable sampled frames
fixed measured master numerator divided by that maximum
findings.original_conclusion: All 13 subjects ACQUIT, with worst sampled ratios from 0.795x to 1.257x.
findings.true_population: All available registered source frames for each subject if exact source maxima are desired.
findings.missing_evidence: Exhaustive registered-frame rendering for exact ratios; none is required to preserve the ACQUIT direction.
findings.exact_replacement_text: All 13 ACQUIT verdicts are monotone-safe. Their exact ratios use max baselines from 13-25 registered frames, but adding source frames can only raise each denominator and lower each fixed-master ratio; no ACQUIT can become CONVICT through exhaustive sampling.

denominator_chain: bare and regularized fields compared sample-for-sample
findings.original_conclusion: The crate's bit-identity claim is TRUE.
findings.true_population: All samples produced by the unified default operator under supported runtime radius resolution.
findings.missing_evidence: The three-plane control is not an exhaustive input-space proof; source unification and the repaired runtime radius path carry the general claim.
findings.exact_replacement_text: Bit identity is upheld on all 8,241,504 samples of each of three real planes and on the in-crate synthetic controls after unifying runtime window-radius resolution. Treat the empirical count as a complete-plane control, not as an exhaustive input-space census.

denominator_chain: hp_energy reported 0 of 15 worse and mean +6.7%
flat controls showed hp_energy rewards noise and artifact
three-subject seam-excluded replacement found +0.3%, +0.0%, and -0.0% outside treatment boundaries
findings.original_conclusion: 0 of 15 crops were worse, mean sharpness was +6.7%, therefore the fix was not a blur.
findings.true_population: The frozen seam-excluded ROI population in the replacement three-subject experiment for the no-blur claim.
findings.missing_evidence: No evidence is missing for replacing the invalid metric; broader subject generalization remains limited to the replacement population.
findings.exact_replacement_text: Void the '0 of 15 worse, mean +6.7%' hp_energy claim. Re-derived outside treatment boundaries, high-frequency energy moves +0.3% / +0.0% / -0.0%; that is the supported no-blur result.

denominator_chain: H7's four registered predictions on the symptomatic stack
three failed including the nominated discriminator
findings.original_conclusion: H7 heterogeneous-PSF averaging is REFUTED.
findings.true_population: All four predictions H7 nominated for this defect diagnosis.
findings.missing_evidence: None about the denominator. A new mechanism would require new predictions rather than adding post hoc H7 successes.
findings.exact_replacement_text: H7 remains REFUTED on its complete four-prediction set: 3 of 4 fail, including its nominated discriminator. The denominator is not an unstated hypothesis universe.

denominator_chain: treated as a real-pixel corpus figure
findings.original_conclusion: 15.1% of real pixels are below crossover and the median is 3.3x past it.
findings.true_population: Each named stack's complete scored pixel population; a corpus figure requires a frozen representative stack population.
findings.missing_evidence: A representative corpus design if one scalar prevalence is still wanted.
findings.resolved_verdict: 15.1% is reproduced on 109MSDCF but refuted as a corpus figure; the measured five-stack range is 3.5%-65.8%. The higher-level opt-in headline survives.
findings.exact_replacement_text: 15.1% is a 109MSDCF result, not a corpus constant. Across the measured five-stack corpus the fraction spans 3.5%-65.8%; the headline that deconvolution remains opt-in survives.

denominator_chain: per-subject and stratum clauses bind at real subject sizes
pooled clause documented as dead code
findings.original_conclusion: At least 90% of cells must pass, but the pooled clause never binds at real subject sizes.
findings.true_population: The complete submitted B6 cell set, partitioned by subject and power stratum.
findings.missing_evidence: Future candidate cells; no denominator is missing from the criterion definition.
findings.exact_replacement_text: The >=90% value is a preregistered criterion, not an observed fraction. It is retained but documented as nonbinding at real subject sizes; powered-cell, subject, stratum, and wrong-direction clauses decide.

denominator_chain: 8 chunk_len=1 many-chunk runs excluded because their concurrency window cannot fill
findings.original_conclusion: The headline working-set fit uses 74 of 82 runs after excluding a stated transient regime.
findings.true_population: The steady-state multi-worker regime the fit models; the excluded transient regime is reported separately.
findings.missing_evidence: No hidden denominator evidence is missing. A model claiming all regimes would need to model the excluded transient cases explicitly.
findings.exact_replacement_text: Headline fit: n=74 steady-state runs from the complete 82-run grid. Eight chunk_len=1 many-chunk runs are excluded by a stated mechanistic rule and reported separately; do not describe the fit as covering that transient regime.

denominator_chain: one symmetric-arm failure diagnosed while the registered placebo passes 3 of 3
findings.original_conclusion: Placebo is 8 of 9 pass and the one failure is diagnosed.
findings.true_population: All nine readings in the frozen placebo grid.
findings.missing_evidence: None about the denominator. The failed symmetric arm remains a reported instrument limitation.
findings.exact_replacement_text: The placebo denominator is the complete nine-reading grid. Eight pass; the single PLsym failure is retained and diagnosed. The registered one-sided PL arm passes on all three stacks.

denominator_chain: strehl and comparator developed through different tone pipelines
block-mean tone map with no fine-resolution information reproduces the apparent gap
findings.original_conclusion: Strehl was 17-27% behind Zerene at 3-5 px features.
findings.true_population: Common-input, common-development comparator outputs scored by an admitted resolution instrument.
findings.missing_evidence: Such common-development comparator outputs; the existing files cannot answer the resolution ranking.
findings.resolved_verdict: The Zerene fine-scale deficit is not measurable on these files and is retracted; the measurement is dominated by development tone, not program resolution.
findings.exact_replacement_text: Retract the 17-27% Zerene fine-scale deficit. A tone mapping built only from 4x4 block averages reproduces or exceeds the apparent band-power gap, so these differently developed files cannot support a resolution ranking.

denominator_chain: all tested against a null-calibrated registration gate
remaining 23 are insufficient for per-band confidence intervals
findings.original_conclusion: The patched focus-stack comparison cannot be computed on co-located regions.
findings.true_population: All 64 regions in the frozen candidate grid.
findings.missing_evidence: A correspondence method or common alignment model that establishes like-for-like content without outcome-selected regions.
findings.exact_replacement_text: The focus-stack comparison is UNMEASURED, not lost: 41 of the complete 64-region grid fail a null-calibrated registration gate, and 23 survivors cannot support the planned per-band intervals.

denominator_chain: fourth band's original gap was below the separate reporting floor
findings.original_conclusion: ARM 2 VERDICT: FAIL because only 3 of 4 fine bands are under 25%.
findings.true_population: All four bands named by the rule as written.
findings.missing_evidence: None about the denominator. A revised rule would require preregistration rather than dropping the below-floor band post outcome.
findings.exact_replacement_text: ARM 2 remains FAIL under the four-band rule as written: 3 of 4 bands pass. Separately report that the failing fourth band began below the 1.34 gap floor and that all three bands carrying the substantive claim pass.

findings.original_conclusion: Rims: strehl is ahead on 3 of 8 comparisons, level on 5, and behind on none.
findings.true_population: The eight admitted rim comparisons in the reported head-to-head design.
findings.missing_evidence: A broader representative comparator population would be needed for a product-wide ranking; none is needed for the eight-comparison result.
findings.exact_replacement_text: Within the eight admitted rim comparisons, strehl is ahead on 3, level on 5, and behind on 0. Do not generalize beyond this fixed comparison set without a new design.

denominator_chain: complete 109MSDCF pixel extent after evidenced safe inset
gate requires success on every stack
findings.original_conclusion: Crop fails the retained-area gate and DEFAULT_COVER_MODE remains Scale.
findings.true_population: All original pixels of every admitted stack; a single complete stack below 80% is sufficient to fail an every-stack rule.
findings.missing_evidence: No denominator evidence can rescue this implementation's current default decision. A repaired early-crop implementation needs a new preregistered run.
findings.exact_replacement_text: The retained-area gate remains FAIL: 109MSDCF retains 64.60% against an at-least-80% every-stack bar. This complete counterexample is sufficient; DEFAULT_COVER_MODE remains Scale.

denominator_chain: one mid-stack proxy frame per subject
proxy validated on one subject as ordering-preserving but effect-compressing
18 proxy wins and four proxy losses
four losses at or below proxy resolution
findings.original_conclusion: The re-fit beats shipped on 18 of 22 scored subjects and loses on four.
findings.true_population: Full delivered masters for the 22 scored subjects if the conclusion is about render quality rather than proxy ordering.
findings.missing_evidence: Full-master re-renders and scoring for all 22 subjects, or a multi-subject calibration proving the one-frame proxy's ordering and resolution.
findings.exact_replacement_text: On the one-mid-stack-frame proxy, the re-fit beats shipped on 18 of 22 subjects. The four apparent losses are at or below proxy resolution. Treat this as proxy ordering, not a 22-master render verdict, until full-master checks exist.

denominator_chain: first, middle, and last frame only
pixel census inside those three frames
four sampled stacks show no value within 39% of white
wording promotes three-frame observation to whole-stack never
findings.original_conclusion: Four of six stacks never come within 39% of the white level; saturation is per-stack and must be detected.
findings.true_population: Every frame of each of the six stacks for a whole-stack 'never' claim.
findings.missing_evidence: An all-frame maximum or a proven bound for the four stacks represented by only first/middle/last frames.
findings.exact_replacement_text: Across the first, middle, and last frames sampled from each of six stacks, four stacks had no sampled pixel within 39% of the white level and two reached saturation. Whole-stack 'never' claims require checking every frame; the evidence still shows saturation cannot be assumed universal.

denominator_chain: both metrics and both stacks evaluated at each site
one boundary-peak site makes the exact 64-site rule fail
unmatched 26/14-frame tails contain none of the 64 observed maxima
findings.original_conclusion: The exact 64-site claim fails rather than being rounded up; the observed unmatched tail has no route to manufacture a dense advantage on this grid.
findings.true_population: All 64 sites in the frozen grid.
findings.missing_evidence: No denominator evidence is missing for this grid. The source correctly refuses to generalize the tail result to an unobserved task.
findings.exact_replacement_text: Rule 18 fails on the complete 64-site grid because only 63 sites peak internally in both metrics and stacks. The 26/14 unmatched tails contain none of those observed maxima; no broader task claim is licensed.

summary_08.non_finding_disposition: Claims not elevated into findings are local table rows, complete deterministic sweeps, fixed fixtures, criteria definitions, exact inventories, or repeated support for a represented finding. They do not independently supply a PASS, FAIL, UNMEASURED, capture admission, promotion, proposal, scorecard, or headline conclusion.
